mentions.note: new member from the Grenadier Guards, 19½ stone; 155 feet hammer, 43 feet shot, 138 feet discus

mentions.h: Best Track Marks AS AT AUG. 22 ... ... ... & Field
SOUTHERN LEAGUE — Wimbledon Park on 3rd June, 1972

mentions.note: back competing in hammer, shot and discus
won 'A' shot 13.54m; 2nd hammer; fouled a winning hammer throw three times
field event stalwart; broke down on the way to the Bournemouth fixture
1973 club rankings: Shot Putt 13.54; Discus 36.12; Hammer 45.74
won Surrey League (1) Colts, 16.51; won Surrey League (3) 18.26
won Surrey League colts races Oct and Nov 1985
returned to Belgrave; 'one of our best ever throwers'

photos.c: Top left. Glyn Ratcliffe, here putting the shot, recently improved our Club Discus record to 48.50m. It had stood since 1956. Top right. Philip Gee, one lap specialist and down to 51.6 this summer. Bottom left. John Martin improved his best Javelin throw to 50.32m in the Club Champs. Bottom right. Belgrave's answer to 'Hercules Unchained' - Eric Barker.
